name: American Home Concepts

niche_evidence.note: Homepage title 'Home Remodeling with American Home Concepts' and the H1 above are generic home remodeling. Kitchen and Bathroom are 2 of 7 service lines beside Basement Remodeling, Door, Window and Siding Replacement and Roofing Repair & Replacement; the newest blog post is about roof replacement. Multi-trade remodeler, same ruling as callenconstruction.com. No vendor credit in footer.

assessment: Opinion: an established Philadelphia-area remodeler, but exterior trades (roofing, siding, windows) sit alongside kitchens and baths, so it is not a kitchen and bath specialist.

name: LM CONSTRUCTION

niche_evidence.quote: General Contractor & Home Remodeling in Bucks & Montgomery Counties, PA.
niche_evidence.note: Homepage title 'General Contractor in Quakertown | Bucks & Montgomery, PA'. Menu lists Kitchens, Bathrooms, Decks, Floors, Finished Carpentry and Paint; the page also advertises framing, decks, floor installations, basements, additions and whole-house remodeling. Multi-trade general contractor. No vendor credit in footer.

name: Yahalom Build LLC

niche_evidence.quote: Remodeling, bathrooms, kitchens, plumbing, electrical, drywall, tile, painting, and complete home renovations — all managed by one experienced team.
niche_evidence.note: Homepage title 'Home Remodeling Tampa Bay | Yahalom Build'; no H1. Menu has a 'Construction Services' group (plumbing and repiping, demolition, drywall, tile, electrical, HVAC, painting, waterproofing) beside whole-home remodeling and room additions; featured work is whole-apartment renovations in Israel. Footer states licensed contracting is provided through RD Home Solutions, LLC (CGC1540719). Multi-trade general contractor. No vendor credit in footer.

assessment: Opinion: a multi-trade Tampa Bay contractor pushing fixed-price bathroom packages, but its title, menu and portfolio lead with general construction and whole-home work.

name: Northeast Dixon Tile Installers

niche_evidence.quote: We are your trusted wallpaper installers with over 15 years of experience.
niche_evidence.note: Site brand is BoldStride Wallpapers (title 'BoldStride Wallpapers'); every service line is wallpaper installation, removal or murals. The Google listing name 'Northeast Dixon Tile Installers' does not match the site. Wallpaper firm. No vendor credit in footer.

assessment: Opinion: a wallpaper installer whose Google listing name does not match its own site; not a kitchen and bath remodeler.

name: GENPRO Remodeling

niche_evidence.quote: Expert Custom Home and DADU Projects in Seattle and Bellevue - Tailored to Your Vision.
niche_evidence.note: Homepage title 'Seattle Home Remodeler - GENPRO'. 'Our Services' lists Kitchens, Tenant Improvements ('Expert Commercial Tenant Improvement Services'), Bathrooms, and Custom Homes & DADU's; the about text opens with 'fine custom new homes, additions'.
